mcp_tools.name: poc_design_kill_criteria_verdict
mcp_tools.title: Poc design kill criteria verdict
mcp_tools.description: Submits a proof-of-concept design record (design premise, criteria-row consistency, timebox window, scope-row consistency, production boundary by design) and returns a deterministic POC_DESIGN_SOUND / POC_DESIGN_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across five sections, including computed criteria-kind and row-consistency checks over the declared rows and window, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared design record made before the run; it runs no POC and judges no idea's worth.

inputSchema.description: The poc design kill criteria verdict manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

poc.description: Proof of concept under design review.

criteria.description: Declared criteria rows: {name, kind, condition_stated, declared_before_run, assesses_house_stack_fit}.

expect.notes: All checks pass. Computed spot checks: criteria_count=2, success_criteria_count=1, kill_criteria_count=1, timebox_duration_days=9, scope_items_count=1, condition_stated_coverage=1.000000
